title: Atlas and Typewriter
author: Isandro Vasquez
blurb: Coral Lockridge, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
